basis: Date withheld by deterministic source validation (Invalid verified disclosure for 0000933974_2023-12-31: invalid date or numeric upper bound). Original assessment: Azenta’s November 13 earnings-call presentation explicitly forecast a mid-teens year-over-year decline in overall revenue for fiscal Q1 2024, the quarter ending December 31, 2023. The revenue row covers all three businesses, including B Medical. A mid-teens decline unambiguously exceeds the 5% decline required. The issuer gave no exact percentage endpoint, so upper_bound is null.

coverage.detail: August 8, 2023. The preceding earnings cycle’s $155–173 million quarterly revenue forecast applied to fiscal Q4 2023, ending September 30. Its $648–665 million outlook covered full-year fiscal 2023.

September 13. The Morgan Stanley presentation based its fiscal 2023 revenue estimate on the August 8 annual guidance midpoint. The earlier-disclosure search found no December-quarter consolidated decline forecast before November 13.
September 26. Azenta reaffirmed the August guidance specifically for fiscal Q4 2023.

November 13. The earnings release gave full-year fiscal 2024 guidance of $696–718 million in total revenue and 5–8% organic growth. The separate earnings-call presentation supplied the December-quarter forecast.

November 13. Under “Q1’24 Key Considerations,” the Revenue row states: “Overall, Q1 expected to decline mid-teens year-over-year.” It separately forecasts combined low-single-digit growth for Multiomics and Sample Management Solutions and an approximately 75% decline for B Medical.
January 11, 2024. The J.P. Morgan presentation used the November 13 full-year guidance midpoint and identified that guidance as historical.

January 31. The exhibit presented historical segment figures for fiscal 2023 and 2022. Its December-quarter comparator was December 2022, with $178 million in total revenue including $42 million from B Medical.

February 7. The GAAP table reports total revenue of $154,317,000 versus $178,366,000 for the December 2023 and December 2022 quarters, respectively. Both totals include B Medical. The actual was below the $169,447,700 threshold.

publication_date_evidence: Azenta’s investor presentation archive dates the Q4 earnings-call deck to November 13, 2023. The deck carries the same date, and the issuer’s same-day release announced a public webcast at 4:30 p.m. Eastern with the presentation materials available through investor relations. https://investors.azenta.com/investor-presentations?o=10
